mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:99 names group 0, index 10 the Light Saber against Item/Sword11.bmd (MODEL_LIGHT_SABER).
why_this_one: Drop level 40: the Ice Queen (52) in Devias, and the Shadow (47), Poison Shadow (50) and Cursed Wizard (54) in the Lost Tower; excellent from the Balrog (66). The last unbuilt weapon in either map's windows but the Crystal Morning Star (2026-10-02).
stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-368: a sword, axe or mace that is TwoHand (width 2) stands PLAYER_STOP_TWO_HAND_SWORD.
two_handed_from: Width 2 in the call; OpenMU's `group < Bows && width == 2` and MuMain's ItemAttribute TwoHand agree.
sheet_from: Data/Item/sword12.OZJ (32x16, shared with the Light Spear) on the 60 triangles of hilt and blade, sword12_2.OZJ (32x16, a green beam on black) on 6.
material_overrides_note: As the Light Spear's, off the same sheet: steel's own 0.2 mirrors the grass.
glow_note: `case MODEL_LIGHT_SABER` with the Spear: BlendMesh 1, BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3+0.7 (ZzzObject.cpp:5309-5312) -- the green beam breathes, as the Light Spear's blue one does. Drawn added on its raw sheet (export_gltf.glow_material).
no_chrome_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:1246: Meshs[1].NoneBlendMesh, so a +7 or +9 saber's chrome and metal passes (ZzzBMD.cpp:1425) stay off the beam.
material_note: The body (60 triangles) is sword12's pale blue-steel -- steel. The six beam triangles are the glow part and wear no material here; their island rows keep steel for the bake only.
